# Lh030 — Lower-case `name` field values where Recommended-Practices keywords are defined

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.1b (`12-1b-header`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-1b-header/Lh030.stp`](../../step-examples/12-1b-header/Lh030.stp)  

## Sources
- 06-nist-sfa S070

## Description

Several Recommended Practices specify lower-case keyword strings as canonical attribute values (e.g. `'composite'` on `geometric_tolerance_relationship`). Producers that emit these in mixed or upper case break receivers that string-compare strictly.

## Reproducer recipe

`GEOMETRIC_TOLERANCE_RELATIONSHIP('Composite',...);` instead of `'composite'`.

## Expected kernel behavior

case-insensitive match for documented RP keyword values on import; warn; emit canonical lower-case on export.

## Notes

Adjacent to Lh018 but specifically about RP-defined string attribute values rather than Part-21 keywords. **See also**: Lh018, Pmi043.
